original_forwarding.cause: finishOnTrap used core.trap.valid instead of the complete system/core trap arbiter; unsupported system instructions never surfaced or retired.

CSR_destination.cause: An unsupported CSR with nonzero rd retained its dependency reservation; a later kernel writing x10 stalled after a correctly reported first fault.

implementation: Capture the complete arbitrated trap in a one-entry queue before the public offer.
A normal finish wins a simultaneous finish-port collision; retain the accepted trap warp in one private pending slot.
Retire the faulting warp only after its public trap is accepted; retain stable PC,cause,tval,mask and warp identity through holds.
Cancel a rejected nonzero CSR destination without a fabricated register write; CSR/memory fault acknowledgements serialize through the CU trap arbiter.
Reset the per-kernel failure flag only for a fresh kernel after all owned trap state drains.
runtime_coverage: EBREAK,ECALL,unsupported CSR and illegal decode with scalar FPU disabled/enabled.
CSR register,immediate and set forms targeting x10, outside ABI-initialized x1..x9; exact healthy destination reuse.
Concurrent CSR rd10 and failing load rd11 on two actual warps, held traps, exact attributed faults and healthy reuse of both registers in both warps.
Default16-lane/eight-warp retirement ownership and eight distinct trap/cease owners under backpressure.
Actual KernelShaderStage unsupported-system failure and healthy reuse, plus healthy scalar-FP and shader controls.

scalar_backend.scope: Default16-lane/eight-warp production ScalarBackend with current native useBlackBoxes=false register implementation; no omitted operators or relaxed clock.

main_promotion: Pending scalar-backend synthesis and integration with newer main.
remaining: Programmable loop watchdog/interruption and general resource/reconvergence contracts.
Native typed/binned host fault integration at product capacity.
